gloss: local area, actual site, on location

definitions.gloss: local area, actual site, on location
definitions.explanation: The place where something actually happens or exists, as opposed to a remote or central location. Emphasizes being physically present at the relevant location, whether domestically or abroad.

examples.japanese: {現地|げんち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: To gather information on the ground.

examples.japanese: {現地|げんち}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧10⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: We are scheduled to arrive at 10 a.m. local time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{現地|げんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦{被災|ひさい}→被災：20184_hisai⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦リポート→リポート：03107_ripooto⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Reporters entered the area and gave a detailed report on the disaster situation.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier: {現地|げんち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (local), {現地|げんち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (on-site, locally). When referring to foreign locations, it emphasizes the perspective of being at that actual place rather than back home. Common in news, business, and travel contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現地|げんち}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: local time
- {現地|げんち}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: on-site investigation
- {現地|げんち}⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧: local staff
- {現地|げんち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: local people
- {現地|げんち}⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧: meeting at the site
